md_015_requirement.summary: Unrelated scoped state change must not invalidate command; verify scoped concurrency not invalidate-all-after-any-change

basis.mechanism: validate_preconditions rejects committed_generation mismatch before review/reuse/analysis scoped checks
basis.scoped_checks_order: generation first, then review_ledger_head, reuse_governance_head, active_analysis_snapshot_identity

consequence.same_class_as_append_01b2: global generation/sequence CAS invalidates command after any unrelated authoritative change
consequence.cannot_claim: SQLite natively conforms to MD-015 scoped validity or provides unrelated-success semantics today

scope_in_this_finding.downstream: After 01B-3 proves scoped-command model, open bounded SQLite scoped-validity preflight; likely smaller fix than Append but not yet authorized

selection_implication: Eliminating Append without fixing SQLite does not resolve Gate 4 MD-015 selection blocker. Dual-candidate selection-eligible evidence requires both candidates to demonstrate scoped validity.
note: Governance finding only. 01C-SQLITE-2 historical acceptance unchanged. No candidate modification in finding record.
